outputs.gen-01-stationary: Month X, until the 4th, when Saturn became stationary to the east, it became stationary 1/2 cubit above β Virginis; Saturn 4 fingers back to the west, visibility: from the 2nd, measured (despite) clouds
outputs.gen-02-last-appearance: The 18th, Mercury’s last appearance in the west, in Pisces; I did not watch; clouds, I did not watch; medium? season
outputs.gen-03-lunar-eclipse: Night of the 14th, moonrise to sunrise: 17°, measured; the north and east wind blew, very overcast; month XI was inserted. Night of the 15th, moonrise to sunrise: 19°; the south wind blew. Year 214, month III, written on the 14th of the preceding month
outputs.gen-04-acronychal-rising: The 14th, Sirius’ acronychal rising; all day very overcast; I did not watch, when I rose the clouds were in the sky, the north wind blew; at 30° after sunrise
